title: Bush and LBJ briefed on JFK assassination at Clint Murchison's ranch

tellings.quote: he was he was in a meeting at the ranch of Clint merchon is where not the one in Waka but the one in Dallas

plain: In 1963, George H. W. Bush, later president, and Lyndon B. Johnson, then vice president, are said to have been briefed on the assassination of President John F. Kennedy at a meeting on the Dallas ranch of the Texas oilman Clint Murchison, "not the one in Waco but the one in Dallas." Dan Sheehan, a guest presented as someone tied up in many of America's famous conspiracy cases, tells it as something passed on to him, and he also brings in J. Edgar Hoover, then head of the FBI. If true, it would mean powerful men knew of the killing ahead of time.
